name: Plans
overview: Scripture teaches that while humans devise their own plans, it is ultimately the LORD who directs their steps and establishes their purposes. Trusting in God rather than relying solely on our own understanding is essential, as committing our works to Him brings stability to our thoughts and intentions. Seeking wise counsel strengthens our plans, but God's sovereign counsel will prevail above all. Moreover, God has gracious plans for His people, plans to prosper them and give them hope for the future.
